comments.name: Global Citizen Max
comments.content: 10-year US Treasury yield hitting 5% and JGB 3% is a big deal, definitely signals global bond market stress. The Fed's rate hike seems like a done deal, which will further impact capital flows. China's retail sales data is mixed, comms up but auto down, reflecting consumer sentiment shifts. As for AI, Huang's dismissal of regulations might be a bit premature, but I agree that innovation shouldn't be stifled by fear-mongering. It's a complex balance.
